tool_input.command:
mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/version-scheme.md <<'EOF'
# Version numbering scheme

This project's current recorded decision is to use Semantic Versioning (SemVer) for version numbers, because its major/minor/patch structure gives users much clearer signals about compatibility when they update.
EOF
cat docs/policies/version-scheme.md

result:
I created `docs/policies/version-scheme.md`. It says the project's current recorded decision is Semantic Versioning, because its major/minor/patch structure gives users clearer compatibility signals when they update.

The source is Muninn decision #25, a user-stated decision. It replaced an earlier CalVer leaning (#23), which the file doesn't mention. I didn't commit the file.

One thing about the lookup: `muninn why` reported "insufficient" for this question, but that was because it found no typed record. The catalog still lists #25 as current. #25 was the only version-scheme record the search returned, and I found nothing newer.
